stemMd: A teacher says handwritten notes improve learning because students who choose handwriting outperform students who choose laptops. Which finding most weakens the causal inference?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some handwritten notes are difficult to read.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Students who choose handwriting already score higher on the subject before the course begins.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The course ends with a written examination.

explanationMd: A pre-existing performance difference supplies an alternative explanation for later scores. The groups are self-selected, so the difference cannot be attributed to note-taking method without accounting for their initial abilities.

distractorRationale.b: Choice is already part of the premise.
distractorRationale.a: A capability alone does not show why scores differ.
distractorRationale.e: Examination format does not eliminate the prior-ability explanation.
distractorRationale.c: Legibility does not establish the observed groups' prior ability.
